title: Friend Delay Scope Boundary
task_prompt:
## task_009: Downstream Candidate -- Friend Delay Scope Boundary

Draft a short, friendly message to Bob Smith explaining that you might reply late tonight because you're catching up on household administrative tasks (bills, scheduling, paperwork, etc.). Give him a quick snapshot of what you're currently tackling so he understands why you're tied up. Keep the tone casual and warm, like texting a close friend.
answer: Hey Bob! I might be slow to reply tonight—I’m catching up on some household admin stuff like bills, scheduling, and paperwork. A bit tied up, but I’ll get back to you when I can 🙂

SUMMARY: The answer successfully maintains a casual, friend-appropriate tone while providing a brief snapshot of household tasks.
